requirements.title: Review and Concur with Electrical Modifications

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Due to simplicity of the project, I am expecting review and stamp in 2 business days. Also, as this is very simple change I was hoping to be stamped for \$100. Pleaslet me know. Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The 36 pages seems daunting but you really don’t need to go through them. I felt the same initiatively but the actual work is just reviewing the minor modifications listed in the word file. I am a mechanical PE for this change and my scope boiled down to the attached file\(only highlighted portion\). Same is the situation for electrical. Let’s finalize it for \$150, if it works for you and I will inform the client. Please advise.

value_updates.review_subject: minor electrical modifications listed in the Word file
value_updates.review_extent: limited to the relevant highlighted modifications rather than a full review of all 36 pages

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The .pdf file is as built drawings copy \(in other words they are as built drawings before this project made some changes\). The electrical changes made as part this project are listed in the word file which you are reviewing and approving \(to amend the as built electrical drawings\) as part of this project.

value_updates.review_baseline: pre-project as-built drawings in the PDF
value_updates.change_source: electrical changes listed in the Word file
value_updates.review_purpose: review and approve the listed changes as amendments to the as-built electrical drawings

source_message.speaker: client
